verdict.rationale: Foreign qualification is a fair question for an incorporation service, so the axis applies. Atlas's documentation covers only Delaware formation, a Delaware registered agent, EIN and 83(b) filings, and never mentions filing foreign qualifications in additional states. Community reports say founders must register in their home state themselves and that Atlas leaves state-level legwork undone; with no vendor claim to contradict, the verdict is none rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
